action.objective: Verify exd4 recapture: does it win back the pawn safely and keep development/castling on track?
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 flags e3d4 (88) and b3d4 (80) as top candidates; both recapture the pawn. Reserved verification targets e3d4 with up to 2000 nodes. Verify it at max depth with full root window and mate probes before committing.
